headline: Foreign investors withdrew ₹44,166 crore from Indian markets in October: disinvestment in 2026 exceeds ₹3 lakh crore; reasons - US bond yields and crude oil prices
summary: Foreign investors withdrew ₹44,166 crore from Indian equity markets in October, with disinvestment in 2026 exceeding ₹3 lakh crore. Reports cite rising global yields and crude oil prices.
why: Foreign institutional flows are a major driver of Indian equity prices and the rupee, and they respond to global yields and oil costs.
